name: average-swan
description: A soft neumorphic action button that sits raised at rest and presses into the surface on activate.
purpose: Gives a tactile, inset-press control for quiet confirmations without leaving the semantic token set.
bestFor: playful product UI that still needs a native button
avoidFor: dense toolbars that cannot spare the raised shadow
